group.headline: One group. Five locations. One strategic vision.
group.body1: MCSC Group is an international advisory group structured across Luxembourg, Monaco, Switzerland, Italy and UK. We work at the intersection of sports, entertainment, and private investments — advising athletes, clubs, investors, and families on how to structure their assets, careers, and transitions.
group.body2: We are not a monolithic structure. We are a coordinated network of specialised entities, each operating within its own regulatory framework, each connected by a shared approach: precision, discretion, and long-term thinking.

expertise.sportsMgmt.desc: MCSC Group provides end-to-end sports management services for professional and emerging athletes, sports clubs, and organisations. Operating from Monaco, we combine deep industry knowledge with an international network that spans Europe and beyond.

team.gian-marco-gilardi.bio: After his graduation in international management and following studies in financial analysis Gian Marco Gilardi has spent his whole career in banking having worked more than 20 years for different primary banks in Switzerland and Monaco. Then he joined and took over the management in 2015 of a single family office in Monaco. On the occasion of a next gen change among the family office in 2022 he has been offered to become a member of a newly created advisory board, a function that he is still occupying. He parallelly diversified his activities by setting up as minority non-managing partner an asset management company in Monaco with a longtime friend. At the same time, he has completed two master courses in private wealth management which allowed him to obtain the qualification of TEP (Trust Estate Practitioner). He finally decided that it was time to realize an old-time dream and became FIFA player agent by taking the exam in 2023. This gave him the input to set up with a previous lawyer and tax advisor and a sport manager a sport management agency in Monaco end of 2024 which later became the MCSC Group. MCSC Group operates in the form of an integrated service consulting company through an open architecture model in cooperation with partners and a network of selected strategic advisors in different fields.
team.francesco-prazzo.bio:
Francesco brings extensive experience in leading global organizations and delivering complex industrial projects in highly regulated, capital-intensive environments. With a multidisciplinary background spanning engineering, law, and international relations, he has held progressively senior roles within the Eni group and later at SBM Offshore.
Throughout his career, he has contributed to the development of large-scale industrial investments and the execution of complex programs across the global energy sector. His expertise encompasses high-level negotiations, the management of complex disputes, and corporate compliance. He has also built strong institutional relationships with governments, public authorities, and international organizations, operating effectively at the intersection of industry and policy.
In parallel, Francesco has maintained a longstanding engagement with the investment world, developing a refined perspective on long-term value creation and the strategic assessment of entrepreneurial opportunities.
He serves as an arbitrator at the Chambre Arbitrale Maritime de Paris and is actively involved in initiatives related to the Blue Economy, industrial sustainability, and technological innovation. In 2024 and 2025, he was recognized among the "100 Who Make Monaco" for his contribution to the development of the Principality's economic and entrepreneurial ecosystem. He also collaborates with universities and academic institutions on topics related to innovation and sustainable development.
Francesco is a co-founder and non-executive member of the Board of Directors of MCSC Group.
team.nathan-cordero-di-montezemolo.bio: Nathan Cordero di Montezemolo graduated in Management and gained valuable experience in the worlds of Formula 1, marketing and events, working across high-performance and brand-driven environments. In 2024, he joined MCSC Management, bringing his strategic insight and international perspective to the team.
team.gianmatteo-terruzzi.bio:
Gianmatteo Terruzzi graduated in Economics and Business Administration from the Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore in Milan and developed his professional foundation within a leading international auditing firm before expanding his expertise across top-tier tax advisory practices in London and Switzerland.
He subsequently held the role of Chief Financial Officer and Head of Operations for a prominent private equity platform focused on the consumer and luxury sectors, overseeing complex, multi-jurisdictional operations across Luxembourg, Switzerland and Italy. This experience shaped a distinctive, strategic perspective combining financial governance, operational execution and cross-border structuring.
He is the founder of LVT Advisors Group, an independent advisory firm delivering integrated tax, corporate and strategic services to international clients across Switzerland, Italy and India, with a strong focus on complex cross-border environments.
A Certified Accountant in the Canton of Ticino, he advises on internationalisation strategies, cross-border structuring and nearshoring projects, with recognised expertise in real estate investments and renewable energy development, supporting investors throughout the full lifecycle of their projects.
Since 2023, he has been Of Counsel at Vester Partners (Milan and Como), where he assists domestic and international clients in the design and implementation of nearshoring strategies, as well as in global mobility and cross-border operational frameworks.
He holds the Independent Director certification issued by the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA) and has built significant governance experience within international environments.
He currently serves on several boards in Switzerland and sits on the board of a company listed on the Mumbai Stock Exchange, where he chairs the Risk Management Committee and is a member of the Audit Committee.
team.martina-bestagno.bio: Martina Bestagno is a sports professional with over 20 years of experience in elite basketball across Italy and Europe. Alongside her athletic career, she has built strong expertise in sport marketing and sports management, specializing in athlete branding, communication, and athlete development. She has collaborated with top-tier clubs and international sports organizations, also contributing as a mentor and workshop creator in media training and dual-career development.
team.cosimo-andrea-vestuti.bio:
Cosimo Andrea Vestuti graduated in Law from the Catholic University of the Sacred Heart in Milan and has been enrolled in the Como Bar Association since 2001 and in that of advocates before the Court of Cassation and Superior Jurisdictions. In 1995 - 1996 he did an internship in Munich (Germany) at the firm 'Gloog und Wald' specialising in international contracts.
Focusing on out-of-court advice, particularly in corporate and business matters, he provides valuable support to entrepreneurs in making strategic choices and current planning.
He has specific knowledge in banking and finance and particular expertise in real estate transactions during the purchase, management and renovation of properties.
team.alessandro-belluzzo.bio:
Alessandro graduated from Bocconi University in Milan with two degrees, in Economics and Law. He then obtained a Master's degree in International Taxation.
Alessandro is a Barrister, registered with the Bar of England and Wales and a TEP – Trust Estate Practitioner in the UK.
He is based in London, where he deals predominately with wealth planning for individuals and family business.
Alessandro has lectured at Bocconi University, and frequently participates as a speaker at national and international conferences, through his role as Deputy Chair of the STEP UK Cross-Border Estates Special Interest Group.
In 2017, Alessandro was made a Knight of the Stella d'Italia. He was nominated for this title by the Italian Ambassador in London, in recognition of Alessandro's work in promoting dialogue between the Italian and British business communities.
In 2025, Alessandro Belluzzo was awarded the title of Officer of the Order of the Star of the Italian Republic for his efforts in modernising the Italian Chamber of Commerce for the UK, as President, and for the international growth of Belluzzo International Partners, which strengthens links between Italian and British business.
From 2019 to 2024, he served as President of the Italian Chamber of Commerce in the United Kingdom.
Since October 2025, Alessandro has been Professor and Director of the Department of Sport & Wealth at the European School of Economics.
team.arvine-zamani.bio:
Member of the Luxembourg bar since 2019 and having worked as a legal and tax advisor since 2012, Arvine represents private individuals, startups, entrepreneurs, young or seasoned, international families, hedge funds, investments funds, institutional clients on corporate law, real estate, tax, estate planning, trusts, funds formation and employment matters or where needed, provides on-site or remote secondments. On a personal level, Arvine has lived in Luxembourg, Brussels, Paris, Geneva, London, Leiden and Tehran and is always keen to exchanging new ideas with a positive mindset, learning and enjoying the time spent during our short yet meaningful journey in life.

Education
Admitted to the Luxembourg bar in 2019
Master of Advanced Studies (LLM) in International Tax Law, Leiden University, 2013
Master in European law, University of Luxembourg, 2011
Erasmus semester at the Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies in Geneva and at the University of Geneva in 2010

Professional experience
Founding investor in a new corporate services startup in Brussels in 2022
Founder of a new legal startup in Luxembourg in 2022
Serving as a director on client companies
Attorney at BSP - 2022 - 2023
Attorney at the international law firm CMS - 2019 - 2022
Associate at the international Swiss Law firm Bonnard Lawson - 2017 - 2019
Consulting assignments 2014 - 2017 at Round Hill Capital, CBRE Global Investors, the European Investment Bank, and Partners Group
Marketing at M3 in London
Tax adviser at KPMG Luxembourg - 2013 - 2014
Junior Associate focusing on corporate and tax matters at wildgen - 2012 - 2013
team.arvine-zamani.role: Member of the Board of Directors of MCSC Holding
team.paolo-zanazza.bio:
Paolo Zanazza is a founding partner of the Law Firm and is specialised in domestic and international commercial and contract law.
Paolo began his career at Rödl & Partner, a leading German law firm, where he was part of the M&A German Desk team. After working with the legal team at KPMG, he joined the Studio Legale Avv. Massimo G. Pedrazzini SA in Lugano in 2015, where he has since been advising Swiss and international clients.
He has extensive experience in corporate law, investment funds, national and cross-border M&A transactions, commercial contracts, financial market regulation, real estate law, corporate governance, and trusts.
He holds a law degree from Bocconi University in Milan, as well as a Joint Degree in International and Business Law from the Freie Universität of Berlin and the University of Paris XII. Additionally, he has a degree in economics and company law, and two Certificates of Advanced Studies in Legal Principles of Companies and in Legal Analysis of Companies from the Scuola universitaria professionale della Svizzera italiana.
He is a member of the board of directors of several companies, including Caimato SA, Terzerina SA and Tifina Holding SA.
team.lada-alekseeva.bio:
Lada Alekseeva is a media and communications professional with an international background in sports, journalism, digital media, and strategic communications.
Lada holds an academic qualification in journalism. Throughout her career, she has worked across television, international sports organizations, and corporate communications, developing expertise in content strategy, media relations, storytelling, and audience engagement.
Before joining MCSC Group, Lada worked in sports media and broadcasting environments (FIFA, Copa 90, NEP, CEV), contributing to international projects and covering major sporting events. Her experience includes editorial production, live content, social media management, and communication initiatives aimed at connecting institutions, brands, athletes, and audiences across different markets.
At MCSC Group, she oversees media and communication activities, including digital strategy, social media development, website management, content creation, partnerships, and brand positioning. She also contributes to strengthening the Group's visibility through strategic storytelling and communication initiatives designed to highlight MCSC's expertise and international network.
team.francesco-bongarra.role: Member of the Board of Directors of MCSC Holding
team.francesco-bongarra.bio:
Francesco Bongarrà is a newsman with a passion for high level diplomacy, politics, culture and academia. After having served for over 25 years as a political journalist and foreign correspondent for the Italian news agency ANSA and several other international media outlet, he was appointed Director of the Italian Cultural Institute in London, the "powerhouse" of Italian culture in the United Kingdom.
He is also Ambassador at Large of the Republic of San Marino - he was previously Ambassador to Peru and to the International Maritime Organization - and a Distinguished Affiliate Scholar at Pembroke College, University of Cambridge. He is a Knight of Magistral Grace of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta and a Knight Grand Officer of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic and of the Order of St Agatha (RSM). A lawyer by background, he chairs the Autorità Garante per l'Informazione (OFCOM) of the Republic of San Marino and sits on the executive boards of the Fondazione Opera Carlo Felice (Genoa, Italy) and of the Thomson Reuters Foundation Inc. (New York, USA).
team.sofia-gilardi.bio:
Sofia Gilardi is a London-based creative and entrepreneur focused on connecting talent, brands, and opportunities across industries. She graduated with honours from Lycée Albert Ier in Monaco, specialising in Philosophy, Economics, and the Arts, before completing a Foundation Diploma in Art and Design (Fashion and Textiles) at the University of the Arts London. She now studies Creative Direction for Fashion at the London College of Fashion.
In 2023, she created Kaiross, a Monaco-based brand that marked the beginning of her entrepreneurial journey and strengthened her interest in brand development, communication, and creative strategy. Alongside her studies, Sofia has gained experience through internships with London-based fashion designers and creative professionals, developing skills in project development, branding, and visual communication.
Passionate about fostering meaningful connections, Sofia aims to create bridges between the worlds of fashion, sport, music, and culture while helping emerging artists and creatives gain visibility and access to new opportunities. Her long-term goal is to combine creativity and entrepreneurship to support talent development and build impactful cross-industry collaborations.
team.massimo-pedrazzini.role: Strategic Advisor to the Group’s Chairman
team.massimo-pedrazzini.bio:
Massimo (Guglielmo) Pedrazzini is a senior attorney with over 40 years of experience in corporate law, commercial law and international taxation, with a strong focus on M&A transactions, corporate restructurings, governance, and cross-border tax planning. He also brings his experience in estate planning and succession execution, including complex wealth structures, generational transfers, trusts, family holding companies, estate planning and cross-border coordination across multiple jurisdictions.
He is founding partner and senior counsel of an independent Swiss law firm assisting multinational groups, entrepreneurs, family offices and boards of directors in complex international matters.
Throughout his career, he has worked extensively across Europe, the United States and Asia, gaining deep expertise in international legal frameworks and cross-border business environments. He regularly acts as a trusted advisor to clients in high-stakes strategic decisions and sensitive corporate matters.
He holds and has held board memberships and governance roles in listed and private companies and foundations, acts and has acted as trustee and protector, contributing strong expertise in management, corporate governance, compliance and strategic oversight.
His professional approach combines:
• strategic vision (board membership)
• legal precision (Swiss and international corporate and contract lawyer)
• practical, business-oriented solution.
team.marco-cordero-di-montezemolo.bio: Marco Cordero Di Montezemolo was born in Bologna on July 1, 1949. He graduated in Law from the University of Rome at the age of 22, achieving the highest distinction of 110/110 cum laude. Following his success in the highly competitive national examination for notaries, in which he obtained the highest possible score, he pursued a distinguished career in the legal profession, practicing in both Rome and Turin. He currently serves as a consultant to one of Turin’s leading notarial firms, drawing on decades of experience and expertise in the field of law and notarial practice.
team.elizaveta-bracht.bio:
Elizaveta Bracht, OLY is an Olympian, sports executive, entrepreneur and strategic advisor with more than 20 years of experience at the intersection of international sport, business and social impact.
Born in Ukraine, she represented Russia throughout her professional volleyball career before establishing Switzerland as her home and professional base. A three-time Olympian and two-time Olympic silver medallist, she competed at the highest level of international sport for more than a decade, earning four European Championship titles and nearly 500 appearances for the Russian National Team.
Following her retirement from elite competition, Elizaveta completed a Master’s degree in Sports Administration (AISTS) in Lausanne and successfully transitioned into the global sports industry. Since then, she has held senior leadership positions with UEFA, FIVB, Volleyball World, the International Boxing Association (IBA) and the Volleyball Foundation, leading initiatives across commercial strategy, marketing, sponsorship, media rights, brand development and major international events.
Throughout her career, she has been deeply involved in the Olympic Movement and has contributed to the delivery and promotion of multiple Olympic Games, combining athlete insight with executive leadership experience.
A recognised advocate for athlete transition and sustainable career development, Elizaveta is particularly passionate about helping athletes prepare for Life After Sport. Drawing on her own journey from Olympic podiums to executive boardrooms, she advises organisations, leaders and athletes on navigating change, building new identities and creating meaningful impact beyond competitive performance.
Having lived in nine countries and travelled to more than one hundred, she brings a uniquely global perspective to leadership, talent development and the future of sport.
team.alexandros-dohn.bio:
Alexandros Dohn is an entrepreneur, business angel and startup advisor with recognised experience in strategic partnerships, business development, marketing, investor relations and the development of startup and investor ecosystems.
He is the CEO and Co-Founder of K2MATCH, a curated platform connecting startups, scaleups, investors, corporates, experts and business communities, and supporting companies through investor access, startup scouting, fundraising preparation and growth-oriented advisory.
He possesses demonstrated credibility, networks and influence in the fields of entrepreneurship, venture investment, investor relations, startup acceleration, business development, strategic partnerships and innovation ecosystems.
Beyond this, Alexandros holds advisory and board roles at a select number of companies. In parallel, he has built deep personal and professional ties across Korea and Asia, regions he sees as defining the next frontier of global innovation.
At the core of everything he does is a personal philosophy rooted in genuine relationship-building: the belief that trust, consistency, and long-term thinking are not soft values, but the hardest and most essential to maintain in business.

faq.a1: MCSC Group is an international advisory group structured across Monaco, Italy, Switzerland, Luxembourg and the UK. We work at the intersection of sports, entertainment, and private investments — advising athletes, clubs, investors, and families on how to structure their assets, careers, and transitions.
faq.q2: Who does MCSC Group work with?
faq.a2: We work with professional and emerging athletes, sports clubs and organisations, agents and managers, investors interested in sports assets, and families seeking to protect and structure wealth across jurisdictions.
faq.a3: Our four strategic pillars cover Advisory (tax, corporate, M&A), Investments (capital allocation, equity stakes), Sports Management (career management, recruitment, event coordination), and Image Rights (structuring, sponsorship, brand partnerships).
faq.a4: We operate through five entities across Europe: MCSC Holding in Luxembourg, MCSC Management in Monaco, MCSC Services Suisse in Lugano, MCSC Management Italia in Milan, and Castle Haus Ltd in London.
faq.q5: How is MCSC Group different from a traditional sports agency?
faq.a5: We are not a traditional agency. We are a coordinated network of specialised entities, each operating within its own regulatory framework. We combine sports management with institutional-grade advisory in tax, corporate structuring, investment, and wealth planning.
faq.q6: Can you help with relocation to Monaco or Italy?
faq.a6: Yes. Through our Italian and Monegasque platforms, we provide onboarding and residence relocation planning, including tax compliance, administrative setup, and lifestyle support.
faq.q7: Do you work with athletes outside of Europe?
faq.a7: Yes. While our entities are based in Europe, we advise clients globally. Our network of strategic partners and advisors extends beyond European borders.

methods.intro.title: Structured, discreet and compliance-aware 360° advisory
methods.intro.body: At MCSC, we do not provide generic advice or fragmented solutions. We act as a trusted strategic partner, helping clients navigate complex personal, professional and commercial situations with structure, discretion and clear accountability.
methods.step1.title: 1. Assessment
methods.step1.body:
Our role is to look at the full picture. We start by understanding the client's objectives, priorities, risks, sensitivities and jurisdictions involved.

This allows us to identify what matters most, what must be protected, and which areas require specialist input.
methods.step2.title: 2. Structuring and Execution
methods.step2.body:
We design and implement a coordinated framework around the client's objectives.

Our aim is to avoid fragmented advice and ensure that all workstreams move in the same direction.
methods.step3.title: 3. Long-Term Governance
methods.step3.body:
We continue to support clients as their careers, families, ventures, regulations and opportunities evolve.

Where appropriate, we coordinate periodic reviews, post-career planning, succession considerations, advisor alignment and strategic reassessment.
methods.approach.label: Learn About Our Expertise
methods.approach.headline: MCSC does not improvise. MCSC orchestrates.
methods.approach.body: We provide a 360° advisory approach to help clients transform talent, reputation, relationships and capital into long-term value.
situations.intro: Our work is often confidential. These anonymised examples illustrate how MCSC supports clients with discretion, compliance awareness and coordinated execution.
situations.case1.title: Emerging Athlete — International Positioning
situations.case1.situation: An emerging athlete needed to move from local visibility to international recognition.
situations.case1.support: We helped define positioning, assess commercial opportunities, coordinate image-rights considerations and prepare a clearer approach to sponsors, clubs and partners.
situations.case1.outcome: A stronger international roadmap and more credible commercial positioning.
situations.case2.title: Former Elite Athlete — Post-Career Transition
situations.case2.situation: A former elite athlete was preparing for life after competition.
situations.case2.support: We coordinated brand positioning, business opportunities, education options, wealth-planning discussions and selected advisor introductions.
situations.case2.outcome: A structured transition from sporting identity to long-term personal and commercial value.
situations.case3.title: Investor — Sports-Related Opportunity
situations.case3.situation: An investor was evaluating exposure to a sports-related asset requiring strategic, operational and governance assessment.
situations.case3.support: We supported initial screening, strategic fit assessment, partner selection and governance readiness. We also prepared an optional full turnaround package involving high-level sports professionals, designed to strengthen the asset's sporting, operational and commercial potential.
situations.case3.outcome: A clearer view of the opportunity, key risks, value-creation options and conditions required before moving forward.
situations.case4.title: Family — Cross-Border Relocation
situations.case4.situation: A family needed to relocate across jurisdictions.
situations.case4.support: We coordinated legal, tax, real estate, administrative and lifestyle introductions, while protecting privacy and priorities.
situations.case4.outcome: A more structured, discreet and manageable relocation process.
situations.case5.title: Athlete — Sharia-Compliant Investment Orientation
situations.case5.situation: An athlete wanted to explore investment options consistent with Islamic principles.
situations.case5.support: We helped frame objectives, risk appetite and ethical constraints, coordinating with appropriate financial, legal and Sharia-aware professionals.
situations.case5.outcome: A clearer understanding of available routes, due diligence needs and regulated advice required before any decision.
situations.case6.title: Major Sporting Events — Season-Long Executive Hospitality
situations.case6.situation: A senior sports executive required high-level hospitality coordination across a full season of major international sporting events.
situations.case6.support: Through our specialist hospitality network, we organised season-long support, including access planning, guest coordination, on-site experience management and liaison with relevant event stakeholders.
situations.case6.outcome: A consistent, premium and discreet hospitality experience throughout the season, ensuring continuity, relationship management and high-quality execution at each event.
situations.case7.title: Football Player — Middle East Transfer
situations.case7.situation: A football player was considering a transfer to a club in the Middle East, involving contractual, financial, family, cultural and cross-border considerations.
situations.case7.support: We supported the player's entourage in assessing the opportunity, coordinating contractual, tax and relocation considerations with the appropriate professionals, and reviewing the broader career, lifestyle, reputational and commercial implications of the move.
situations.case7.outcome: A clearer decision-making framework for the player and family, with the sporting opportunity assessed alongside financial, personal and long-term career considerations.
